notes: Read SKILL.md, references/context-safety.md, github-issues.md, redaction-policy.md, session-discovery.md, templates/bundle-README.md, case.md, issue.md, report.md, and prompts/analyst-common.md, cost-and-time.md, plan-adherence.md, quality-evidence.md, repeated-work.md, request-conflicts.md, scrub.md, scrub-audit.md, similar-session.md, skill-timeline.md, stumbles.md in full. Diagnoses a misbehaving superpowers agent session: after intake with the user, it reads session transcripts on disk read-only, dispatches analyst subagents per dimension, writes a cited report, and optionally files a GitHub issue or builds a scrubbed export bundle.

Medium: runs bounded shell reads (wc, awk, sed, jq) over local transcript files, creates a workspace under ~/.superpowers/diagnosing-superpowers/<session-id>/ (SKILL.md:33), searches obra/superpowers issues via `gh` or the public GitHub API with curl, and can run `gh issue create` and zip/tar a bundle. Acceptable because session files are strictly read-only (SKILL.md:90, context-safety.md:22), issue creation happens only after the user approves the exact text (SKILL.md:52-53,101-103; github-issues.md:26-27), bundles are built only on request, scrubbed per redaction-policy.md with an independent audit, and archived only after the user sees the scrub log (SKILL.md:55-66).

Session transcripts are privacy-sensitive (prompts, code, possibly secrets); the skill redacts secrets to `<SECRET-n>` placeholders and states that scrubbing can miss things and the user must review every file before sharing (SKILL.md:65-66). All referenced references/, templates/ and prompts/ files are present in the directory.
